ADC_RULE_GROUPS

Table to store ADC rule groups.

Columns
crg_id

PK, technical key

crg_app_id

ID of the APEX application the rule group refers to

crg_page_id

ID of the APEX page the rule group refers to

crg_decision_table

Decision logic to decide upon the rule to execute based on session state and event metadata

crg_initialization_code

Generated code to calculate the initial data of page items

crg_with_recursion

Flag to indicate whether the rule group allows recursive execution

crg_active

Flag to indicate whether the rule group is in use
